cv.title: My CV
cv.description: Write your details once. The PDF, the version tailored to each offer and the cover letters all come from here.
cv.notSaved: You haven't saved your CV yet. Fill it in and press Save.
cv.previewFailed: The preview could not be generated.

fields.headline: Headline
fields.headlineHint: One line: your role or speciality
fields.toHint: Leave empty if it is your current job
fields.achievementsHint: One per line, with measurable results when you have them

cv.includeSection: Show this section in the PDF
cv.includeHint: Everything is saved; this only decides what appears in the PDF.
cv.hiddenNote: This section will not appear in the PDF, but it is kept.

import.title: Import a CV
import.description: Upload a file and we fill in the form for you. Nothing is saved until you review it and press Save.
import.drop: PDF, Word (.docx) or the LinkedIn ZIP · 5 MB maximum
import.replaces: It will replace what is in the form now (what you already saved does not change until you save).
import.slow: It can take up to a minute: the file is read on this machine, without sending your data to third parties.
import.linkedinBody: LinkedIn does not offer a free direct connection, but you can download your data: Settings → Data privacy → “Get a copy of your data” → pick Profile, Positions, Education, Skills, Certifications and Languages. You get a ZIP: upload it as it is.
import.onlyKnown: Only PDF, DOCX or the LinkedIn ZIP are accepted.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
import.done: CV imported. Review each section and press Save.
import.noticeTitle: Imported from {source}. Review the data before saving.

warnings.unverified: {count, plural, one {One text the reader could not find in the document was left out} other {# texts the reader could not find in the document were left out}}: fill it in by hand if it was needed.
warnings.linkedinNoAchievements: LinkedIn does not export bulleted achievements: add the achievements of each position.
warnings.referencesHidden: References were left out of the PDF; switch them on in their section to include them.

offers.title: Job offers
offers.description: Ordered by how close they are to your CV. Each one links to where it was published: that is where you apply.
offers.refreshNote: Each source is asked at most once every 6 hours.
offers.needCvBody: Offers are ranked against your CV, so it has to be saved first.
offers.summary: {shown} shown of {total}; {excluded} excluded by your rules.
offers.pending: Working out how well {count} new offers fit you. This list updates by itself.
offers.emptyHint: Press “Look for new offers” to fetch some.
offers.score: Fit with your CV: {score} out of 100

rules.title: Rules that drop an offer
rules.description: An offer that breaks any of these is left out of the list.
rules.locationsHint: Empty means any. For example: worldwide, latam
rules.requiredTechnologiesHint: The offer must mention all of them

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: What you prepared for each offer. Careers never sends anything: you apply on the offer's page and record it here.
applications.empty: You haven't prepared any application yet.
applications.never: Careers sends nothing. Review your CV and the letter, apply on the offer's page, then mark it here.
applications.letterHint: It comes from a template filled with your own CV data and only names technologies you declared. You can rewrite it.
applications.cvHint: The same CV, showing first what matters most for this offer.

errors.ai-unavailable: The AI service is not available right now. Nothing was saved; try again in a moment.
errors.invalid-transition: That step is not allowed from the application's current status.
errors.already-prepared: This offer already has a draft.
errors.unavailable: The Careers service is not available right now.
errors.notConfigured: The Careers module is not configured.
errors.import-sin-texto: The PDF has no readable text (it looks like a scan). Try another file or fill in the form by hand.
errors.import-formato-desconocido: I do not recognise that file. Use a PDF, a Word (.docx) or the LinkedIn ZIP.
errors.import-demasiado-grande: The file is too large (5 MB maximum).
errors.import-ilegible: The file could not be read: it may be damaged or protected.
errors.import-zip-sin-datos: That ZIP does not contain the LinkedIn profile files (Profile, Positions, Education…).
errors.import-ia-fallo: The document could not be interpreted right now. Try again or fill in the form by hand.

pdfFailed: The PDF could not be generated.

view.title: Saved CV
view.description: This is how your CV is saved. To change anything, use Edit.
view.emptyTitle: There is no saved CV yet
view.emptyBody: Fill in the form and press Save to see it here.
view.legend: Anything marked “Not in the PDF” is saved but left out of the document.
